Target value placeholders differ from the source value.

The check is on by default, with the severity `error`.



## Configure

Change the severity, or turn the check off, in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from 'x18n'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'placeholder-mismatch': 'off',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only placeholder-mismatch` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip placeholder-mismatch` skips it for one run.
